step1_analysis.description: A fully differential OTA featuring a main amplification path and a feedforward auxiliary path. This architecture is typically used to achieve both high DC gain and high unity-gain bandwidth, making it suitable for the MDAC in high-speed pipelined ADCs.

dc_gain.description: Low-frequency differential voltage gain of the OTA.

sky130_expected.calculation: Gain is proportional to gm * Rout. With L=0.5um in SKY130, intrinsic gain per stage is around 25-30dB. A two-stage/cascoded structure yields ~50dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: SKY130 at 1.8V has lower gm/Id compared to 65nm at 1.0V, but the longer channel length (0.5um) provides decent output resistance, keeping the gain comparable to the paper.

ugf.description: Unity Gain Frequency, where the open-loop gain drops to 0 dB.

sky130_expected.calculation: UGF = gm / (2 * pi * Cload). Assuming gm ~ 1mA/V and Cload = 100fF, UGF ~ 1.5GHz. However, internal parasitic poles will lower this.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The 130nm process is slower than 65nm, resulting in higher parasitic capacitances for the same gm, which reduces the achievable bandwidth.

phase_margin.description: Phase difference from -180 degrees at the Unity Gain Frequency, indicating stability.

sky130_expected.calculation: Determined by the location of the non-dominant pole relative to the UGF. Feedforward compensation typically introduces a LHP zero to boost phase.
sky130_expected.reasoning: A phase margin of ~60 degrees is standard target for stable settling in pipelined ADC op-amps.

power.description: Total static power consumption of the op-amp.

sky130_expected.calculation: Power = VDD * Itotal. With VDD=1.8V and estimated total bias current of 400uA across all branches.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Operating at 1.8V in 130nm requires more power to achieve similar bandwidths compared to a 1.0V 65nm design.

slew_rate.description: Maximum rate of change of the output voltage during a large-signal step.

sky130_expected.calculation: SR = Itail / Cload. With Itail ~ 200uA and Cload = 100fF, SR ~ 2000 V/us.
sky130_expected.reasoning: High slew rate is required for 200MS/s operation (5ns clock period, ~1-2ns allocated for slewing).

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure DC gain, UGF, phase margin, slew rate, and power consumption of the dual-path OTA. Ideal CMFB loops are used to stabilize the high-impedance output nodes.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Dual-Path OTA Testbench

.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

* Parameters
.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u
.param W_xm8=5u L_xm8=0.5u
.param W_xm9=5u L_xm9=0.5u
.param W_xm10=5u L_xm10=0.5u
.param W_xm11=5u L_xm11=0.5u
.param W_xm12=5u L_xm12=0.5u
.param W_xm13=5u L_xm13=0.5u
.param W_xm14=5u L_xm14=0.5u

* DUT
XM1 N3 N8 N2 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N6 N8 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N3 LABEL_NET_0 N1 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 N10 N9 N7 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 N2 LABEL_NET_1 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 N4 LABEL_NET_2 N1 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM7 N4 N0 N2 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}
XM8 N10 N11 N1 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm8} w={W_xm8}
XM9 N7 N0 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm9} w={W_xm9}
XM10 N4 N5 N1 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm10} w={W_xm10}
XM11 N5 N9 N6 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm11} w={W_xm11}
XM12 N3 LABEL_NET_3 N1 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm12} w={W_xm12}
XM13 N5 N11 N1 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm13} w={W_xm13}
XM14 N1 LABEL_NET_5 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm14} w={W_xm14}

* Fix missing connection from OCR (LABEL_NET_3 is the symmetric counterpart to N5)
Vshort LABEL_NET_3 N10 0

* Power supply
VVDD VDD 0 1.8

* Biases
Vbias_tail LABEL_NET_1 0 0.7
Vbias_casc N9 0 1.1
Vbias_ptail LABEL_NET_5 0 1.0

* Ideal CMFB for main outputs (N4, N3) to hold CM at 0.9V
Ecmfb1_1 LABEL_NET_0 0 vol='1.0 + 5*( (v(N4)+v(N3))/2 - 0.9 )'
Ecmfb1_2 LABEL_NET_2 0 vol='1.0 + 5*( (v(N4)+v(N3))/2 - 0.9 )'

* Ideal CMFB for aux outputs (N5, N10) to hold CM at 0.9V
Ecmfb2 N11 0 vol='1.0 + 5*( (v(N5)+v(N10))/2 - 0.9 )'

* Inputs (Combined AC and Tran)
Vac_p in_ac_p 0 dc 0 ac 0.5
Vac_n in_ac_n 0 dc 0 ac -0.5

Vtran_p in_tran_p 0 pulse(0 0.5 1n 10p 10p 10n 20n)
Vtran_n in_tran_n 0 pulse(0 -0.5 1n 10p 10p 10n 20n)

E_inp N8 0 vol='0.9 + v(in_ac_p) + v(in_tran_p)'
E_inn N0 0 vol='0.9 + v(in_ac_n) + v(in_tran_n)'

* Differential output
Ediff out_diff 0 vol='v(N4) - v(N3)'

* Load capacitors
Cload1 N4 0 100f
Cload2 N3 0 100f

.control
* 1. DC Operating Point & Power
op
let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
print power

* 2. AC Analysis (Gain, UGF, Phase Margin)
ac dec 100 1k 10G
let gain_db = vdb(out_diff)
let phase = 180/PI * cph(v(out_diff))
meas ac dc_gain find gain_db at=1k
meas ac ugf when gain_db=0 fall=1
meas ac phase_at_ugf find phase when gain_db=0 fall=1
let pm = phase_at_ugf + 180
print dc_gain ugf pm

* 3. Transient Analysis (Slew Rate)
tran 10p 20n
meas tran t_rise trig v(out_diff) val=-0.5 rise=1 targ v(out_diff) val=0.5 rise=1
let sr_rise = 1.0 / t_rise
meas tran t_fall trig v(out_diff) val=0.5 fall=1 targ v(out_diff) val=-0.5 fall=1
let sr_fall = 1.0 / t_fall
print sr_rise sr_fall

quit
.endc
.end
